thag16.3:1.1: Cirarattaṃ vatātāpī dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ samaṃ cittassa nālatthaṃ pucchaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇe: || ||
thag16.3:2.1: ko so pāraṃgato loke, ko patto amatogadhaṃ, kassa dhammaṃ paṭicchāmi paramatthavijānanaṃ. || ||
thag16.3:3.1: antovaṅkagato āsiṃ maccho va ghasam āmisaṃ, baddho Mahindapāsena Vepacity āsuro yathā. || ||
thag16.3:4.1: añcāmi naṃ na muñcāmi asmā sokapariddavā. ko me bandhaṃ muñcaṃ loke sambodhiṃ vedayissati. || ||
thag16.3:5.1: samaṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vā kaṃ ādisantaṃ pabhaṅgunaṃ, kassa dhammaṃ paṭicchāmi jarāmaccupavāhanaṃ. || ||
thag16.3:7.1: taṇhādhanusamuṭṭhānaṃ dve ca pannarasāyutaṃ passa orasikaṃ bālaṃ bhetvāna yadi ṭhati. || ||
thag16.3:8.1: anudiṭṭhīnaṃ appahānaṃ saṃkappasaratejitaṃ tena viddho pavedhāmi pattaṃ va māluteritaṃ. || ||
thag16.3:9.1: ajjhattaṃ me samuṭṭhāya khippaṃ paccati māmakaṃ, chaphassāyatanī kāyo yattha sarati sabbadā. || ||
thag16.3:10.1: taṃ na passāmi tekicchaṃ yo me taṃ sallam uddhare nānārajjena satthena nāññena vicikicchitaṃ. || ||
thag16.3:11.1: ko me asattho avaṇo sallam abbhantarāpassayaṃ ahiṃsaṃ sabbagattāni sallaṃ me uddharissati. || ||
thag16.3:12.1: dhammappati hi so seṭṭho visadosapavāhako gambhīre patitassa me thalaṃ pāṇi va dassaye. || ||
thag16.3:14.1: uddhaccameghathanitaṃ saṃyojanavalāhakaṃ vāhā vahanti kuddiṭṭhiṃ saṃkappā rāganissitā. || ||
thag16.3:15.1: savanti sabbadhī sotā, latā ubbhijja tiṭṭhati: te sote ko nivāreyya, taṃ lataṃ ko hi checchati. || ||
thag16.3:16.1: velaṃ karotha bhaddante sotānaṃ sannivāraṇaṃ, mā te manomayo soto rukkhaṃ va sahasā luve. || ||
thag16.3:17.1: evaṃ me bhayajātassa apārā pāram esato tāṇo paññāvudho satthā isisaṃghanisevito || ||
thag16.3:18.1: sopānaṃ sukataṃ suddhaṃ dhammasāramayaṃ daḷhaṃ pādāsi vuyhamānassa mā bhāyīti ca m' abravī. || ||
thag16.3:19.1: satipaṭṭhānapāsādaṃ āruyha paccavekkhisaṃ yan taṃ pubbe amaññissaṃ sakkāyābhirataṃ pajaṃ. || ||
thag16.3:20.1: yadā ca maggam addakkhiṃ nāvāya abhirūhanaṃ anadhiṭṭhāya attānaṃ tittham addakkhim uttamaṃ. || ||
thag16.3:21.1: sallaṃ attasamuṭṭhānaṃ bhavanettipabhāvitaṃ etesaṃ appavattāya desesi maggam uttamaṃ. || ||
thag16.3:22.1: dīgharattānusayitaṃ cirarattapatiṭṭhitaṃ buddho me pānudī ganthaṃ visadosapavāhano 'ti. || || Telakāni thero.
